rationale: National e-procurement platform with searchable banking/payment tenders naming awarded suppliers — durable standalone vendor-intel source.
Statutory award-notice bulletin naming winning suppliers; verification failed so re-check liveness before approving.
Statutory contract register with full contract PDFs — richest legal disclosure of Czech bank/payment vendor names and values.
Machine-readable distribution of the same register; the practical longitudinal ingestion feed.
MMR methodology hub explaining where evidence must be published — mine once to design coverage, not a signal stream.
ČNB contracting profile exposes below-threshold central-bank payment/IT buys invisible elsewhere.
Static ČNB pointer page on a domain already monitored; routes to E-ZAK/Gemin, adds no independent signal.
E-marketplace capturing ČNB long-tail IT spend, but URL verification failed — re-check reachability.
Multi-tenant profile platform hosting Česká pošta, EGAP and NRB — state financial buyers of payment systems.
Pointer page that merely routes to the already-covered Tender arena profile.
EGAP procurement pointer resolving to its Tender arena profile; covered by the platform source.
A real state bank's contracting profile — rare public view of a Czech bank's core-banking/payment vendor stack.
Ministry of Finance profile covers state treasury/payment infrastructure and framework agreements with payment vendors.
Civic-tech aggregator with API supporting vendor-ICO and CPV queries — best single entry point for competitor mapping.
Third-party mirror of data already covered officially; redundant except as fallback search.
Additional profil-zadavatele host needed for full coverage of fragmented Czech publication channels.
Third commercial e-tool hosting authority profiles; required to avoid coverage gaps in vendor-award data.
Regulator decision database reveals losing bidders, disputes and lock-in claims in banking/IT procurement.
Service documentation on publication mechanics and exemptions; read once to bound coverage claims.
National open-data catalogue as ongoing discovery index for new structured procurement feeds.
Live DPS is a continuously updated public register of qualified payment-gateway suppliers to the Czech state.
EU notice portal giving structured Czech award notices with winning supplier and consortium names.
Official API enabling standing CZ+CPV award queries diffable run-over-run to detect new vendor entries.
Bulk XML archive enables retrospective share-of-wins history for Czech banking/payments contracts.
Schema reference needed once to parse notice fields (winner, value, subcontracting); not a signal stream.
Analysis-ready TED derivatives on the EU open data portal; useful trend layer and completeness cross-check.
CPV taxonomy is a one-time query-design asset defining which contract classes get seen.
EU funding portal names Czech beneficiaries and consortium partners, exposing vendor partnerships and reference projects.
